extraction_notes: Zener semantics preserved: the nominal breakdown voltage is paired with the tabulated IZT test current.
The BZT52C18 table row gives VZ = 17.10 V minimum, 18.00 V nominal, and 18.90 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT maximum = 45 ohm at IZT; ZZK maximum = 225 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; admissible IZM = 5 mA.
The BZT52C18 temperature-coefficient bounds are 12.4 to 16.0 mV/degC at IZTC, as listed on p. 2.

The six zener-characteristic points are graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C18 trace in p. 3 Fig. 2 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; they are not interpolated or synthesized. The figure states Ta = 25 degC, pulsed, and shows a PD = 500 mW envelope.

Capacitance is shown only as family-level typical curves in p. 3 Fig. 3 at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz, with 0 V, 1 V, and 50% of nominal VZ bias curves; no tabulated BZT52C18 capacitance value is provided, so capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery-time specification or test circuit is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null.
Absolute maximum PD is 350 mW on p. 1; the p. 3 pulsed characteristic plot separately shows a 500 mW envelope and is preserved as the plot condition rather than substituted for the rating.
